blockingFinding.finding: evaluationCondition required-capability-unavailable is accepted without an authoritative capability-failure artifact and can override otherwise complete normalized evidence.
blockingFinding.impact: Core could self-assert unable-to-proceed after evidence collection without a deterministic source fact.
blockingFinding.recommendedResolution: Treat unable-to-proceed as a pre-evaluation module outcome, like baseline-drift, and produce neither VerificationPolicyEvaluation nor WorkItemVerificationGateCandidate. Restrict policy evaluation and candidates to verified, failed, and needs-evidence.
